verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of event-driven rules is budgets: users set spend thresholds that send budget notifications and can publish to Pub/Sub topics for programmatic cost-control responses. Personalized Service Health also mentions custom alerts. Both are narrow, domain-specific triggers rather than a general rule-to-action engine, and the Pub/Sub snippet is truncated. missing for 10: a general-purpose event-routing or trigger service (e.g., rules that invoke functions or workflows on resource events), documentation of how actions are configured and executed beyond notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
